question: top 5 custmers by revenue
sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: give top 5 channels based on expenditure on marketting
sql:
SELECT channel, SUM(amount_spent) AS total_spent
FROM marketing_spend
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: top 5 customers by least order revenue, top 5 product with least revune, top 5 regions by least average order value, top channels by least marketing
sql:
SELECT p.id,
       p.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS revenue
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY revenue ASC
LIMIT 5;

question: top 5 customers by least order revenue, top 5 product with least revune, top 5 regions by least average order value, top channels by least marketing
sql:
SELECT c.region, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY avg_order_value ASC
LIMIT 5;

question: What are the names of the top 5 customers with the lowest order revenue?
sql:
SELECT c.name
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) ASC
LIMIT 5;
